drivingQuestion: When is the firmament seen 'in its purity' so that one blesses 'Author of creation'?
outcomeNote: Abaye answers when the firmament is in its purity; the Gemara then notes that Rav Ḥisda (via Rafram bar Pappa) denies it has been seen so since the destruction, and the dispute is left standing.

segments.he: אָמַר רַבִּי יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בֶּן לֵוִי: הָרוֹאֶה רָקִיעַ בְּטׇהֳרָתָהּ, אוֹמֵר: ״בָּרוּךְ … עוֹשֵׂה בְרֵאשִׁית״. אִימַּתִּי? אָמַר אַבָּיֵי: כִּי אָתֵי מִטְרָא כּוּלֵּי לֵילְיָא, וּבְצַפְרָא אָתֵי אִסְתָּנָא וּמְגַלְּיָא לְהוּ לִשְׁמַיָּא.
segments.en: «Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi said: One who sees the firmament in its purity recites: Blessed…Author of creation.» The Gemara asks: «When» does the firmament appear in its purity? «Abaye said: When rain» falls «all night and in the morning a northern wind blows, exposing the heavens.»

segments.he: וּפְלִיגָא דְּרַפְרָם בַּר פָּפָּא אָמַר רַב חִסְדָּא. דְּאָמַר רַפְרָם בַּר פָּפָּא אָמַר רַב חִסְדָּא: מִיּוֹם שֶׁחָרַב בֵּית הַמִּקְדָּשׁ לֹא נִרְאֵית רָקִיעַ בְּטׇהֳרָתָהּ, שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר: ״אַלְבִּישׁ שָׁמַיִם קַדְרוּת וְשַׂק אָשִׂים כְּסוּתָם״.
segments.en: The Gemara notes: «And» in this they «disagree with Rafram bar Pappa» who said that «Rav Ḥisda said, as Rafram bar Pappa said» that «Rav Ḥisda said: Since the day the Temple was destroyed the firmament has not been seen in its purity, as it is said: “I clothe the heavens with blackness and I make sackcloth their covering”» (Isaiah 50:3).
